name: Outsrc
tagline: Routes coding jobs to the terminal agents already installed on your machine
description: A local dispatcher that farms your bot's programming work out to the command-line coding agents you already pay for, naming Claude Code, Codex and xAI's Grok Build among them. Every job runs in a fresh git worktree so nothing collides, and the result returns as a diff you review before keeping it.
author: edtadros
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
